title: One Man Went to Mow
transcription:
One Man Went to Mow

One man went to mow,
went to mow the meadow,
One man and his dog,
went to mow the meadow.

Two men went to mow,
went to mow the meadow,
Two men, one man and his dog,
went to mow the meadow.

Three men went to mow,
went to mow the meadow,
Three men, two men, one man and his dog
went to mow the meadow.

so forth until ten men, getting faster each
verse.
